corrected_keys.r1_finding: RU-HUB-P1 (MAJOR) — the taxonomy label sat after 'в категории', which governs the prepositional case, while the render site passes the label in the nominative; ungrammatical for all 16 labels, and the en sidecar forbids declining or re-casing the placeholder.
corrected_keys.evidence: Rendered the shipped template against all 16 ru taxonomy labels (ui.hub.taxonomy.category.*: Бухгалтерия, Аналитика, Образование, Здравоохранение, Инвестиции, Право, Управление, Маркетинг, Другое, Личная помощь, Исследования, Ролевые игры, Продажи, Безопасность, Соцсети, Программирование). Every rendering is grammatical and idiomatic, e.g. 'В категории «Программирование» нет агентов.', 'В категории «Право» нет агентов.', 'В категории «Ролевые игры» нет агентов.'. «ёлочки» is the ru style guide's prose quote pair (i18n/style-guides/ru.md, 'Punctuation & typography': 'Quotes: «ёлочки» in prose'), and the catalogue already cites untouchable placeholders that way, so the citation form matches both the sidecar instruction and the house style. The 'All categories' label cannot reach this key: the sidebar's All row calls onSelectCategory(null) (agent-categories-sidebar.tsx:126) and the render site's `selectedCategory ? … : …` ternary (agent-hub-page.tsx:1452) then takes the search/public branch, so 'В категории «Все категории» нет агентов.' is not a reachable string.

corrected_keys.r1_finding: RU-HUB-P2 (MAJOR) — 'его' is masculine/neuter and cannot refer to a feminine organization; in the reachable fallback (orgName null → scope.org_unnamed 'этой организации') the pronoun attached to the masculine 'хабе', reading 'for the hub's members'.
corrected_keys.now: Агенты, опубликованные в хабе {org}, появятся здесь для участников этой организации.
corrected_keys.verdict: fixed — the pronoun is gone and the new tail binds correctly for both placeholder branches
corrected_keys.evidence: The referent is now a fixed genitive noun phrase, 'участников этой организации', with no pronoun to agree with anything: it is correct whether {org} renders as a name or as the fallback. Rendered both branches: [этой организации] 'Агенты, опубликованные в хабе этой организации, появятся здесь для участников этой организации.' — grammatical, both occurrences in valid case (prepositional after 'в хабе', genitive after 'для участников'); [Альфа / Ромашка / Acme Corp] '…в хабе Альфа, появятся здесь для участников этой организации.' — grammatical, with 'этой организации' deictically bound to the org just named. Feminine agreement is no longer being asked of the placeholder at all, so it cannot break for a feminine, masculine or indeclinable org name. Note this string is byte-identical to what r1's own proposed repair ('для участников {org}') would render in the fallback branch, and strictly better than it in the named branch, where a bare declinable name after a genitive would have been ungrammatical.

checks.changed_scope: Exactly 2 ru lines changed, value-only; 0 keys added, 0 removed, 0 renamed, 0 reordered; file 61 lines before and after; JSON parses; tab indentation preserved; no BOM, no CRLF.
checks.placeholders: {category} and {org} each appear once, byte-identical to the English placeholders (ASCII braces, ASCII identifier names), in a sensible slot; braces balanced in both values; no placeholder invented, dropped, translated or duplicated; placeholder-set parity with en holds for all 59 keys.
checks.characters: NFC; no NBSP/U+202F/ZWSP/BOM or bidi controls introduced; the only non-ASCII non-Cyrillic characters in the two values are U+00AB and U+00BB in the category title, which the style guide prescribes; no double or edge spaces; trailing full stop kept in both.
checks.grammar_category: All 16 shipped taxonomy labels (ui.hub.taxonomy.category.*) were rendered into 'В категории «{category}» нет агентов.' and every one reads as a grammatical, natural Russian sentence: 'В категории «Бухгалтерия» нет агентов.' … 'В категории «Ролевые игры» нет агентов.' Quoting turns the label into a citation, which is exactly what the en sidecar asks for ('insert it whole, do not decline or re-case it'): the prepositional government of 'в категории' stops at the quote mark and nothing inside has to agree. Multi-word and plural labels ('Личная помощь', 'Ролевые игры', 'Соцсети') work unchanged — the reason the old unquoted form failed for all 16.
checks.grammar_org_feminine: The correction removes the gender-bound pronoun. 'участников этой организации' is a fixed genitive phrase; 'в хабе {org}' keeps its prepositional antecedent. Verified with the shipped fallback and with feminine, indeclinable and masculine-looking names.
checks.naturalness_whole_string: Title → body → button read as one set in both corrected keys: 'В категории «Программирование» нет агентов.' / 'В этой категории пока ничего нет. Сбросьте фильтр, чтобы увидеть весь хаб.' / 'Сбросить фильтр' share the noun 'фильтр' and the imperative register; 'В этой категории' picks the quoted category up cleanly. The org pair 'У этой организации пока нет общих агентов.' / '…появятся здесь для участников этой организации.' is grammatical, though the fallback branch repeats the noun phrase — see RU-HUB-R2-1.

Both name the audience with 'участники' (the style guide's settled word for member) and both avoid a pronoun for the organization, so the pair the r1 finding asked to keep in step is in step. The remaining asymmetry — pages names the org twice, teams once — is the MINOR below, not a break of the parallel.

observations: 'в хабе {org}' is apposition: correct with the shipped fallback 'этой организации' and with an indeclinable foreign name; a declinable Russian name (Ромашка) would want «ёлочки». The construction is carried over unchanged from be77d308262 and was recorded in r1's observations, so it is out of scope for this delta rather than a finding.

scope.org_unnamed and org.that_organization are the same ru string, 'этой организации'; the collapse is correct because both slots demand an oblique case and Russian's feminine demonstrative does not distinguish them. It also means the corrected org body renders identically whichever of the two the caller passes.

The r1 proposal ('для участников {org}') and the shipped string are not the same change: the shipped form hard-codes the fallback phrase so that a real org name is never forced into the genitive after 'для участников'. A later reader comparing the r1 text with the commit should not read the difference as an unremediated finding.
